title: target_report
description: The per-target rollup object (docs/UNIFIED_OUTPUT_CONTRACT.md). Only the slots this renderer consumes are constrained; additionalProperties TRUE keeps the many additive rollup slots (risk_6dim, modality_fit, robustness, …) and future ones valid.

skill_reports.description: {short: skill_report} — the spine collection the renderer reads. Each value is validated against skill_report.schema.json separately (kept as a shallow object here to avoid cross-file $ref resolution across jsonschema versions).
